alternative_data_access.method: JOIN queries through child tables with direct relationships

example_queries.get_source_object_id: SELECT po.id, po.object_name, po.object_type, CASE WHEN pt.id IS NOT NULL THEN pt.source_table_id WHEN pv.id IS NOT NULL THEN pv.source_view_id WHEN pf.id IS NOT NULL THEN pf.source_function_id WHEN psp.id IS NOT NULL THEN psp.source_procedure_id END as source_object_id FROM mcl.postgres_objects po LEFT JOIN mcl.postgres_tables pt ON pt.id = po.id LEFT JOIN mcl.postgres_views pv ON pv.id = po.id LEFT JOIN mcl.postgres_functions pf ON pf.id = po.id LEFT JOIN mcl.postgres_stored_procedures psp ON psp.id = po.id;
example_queries.get_postgres_table_data: SELECT pt.*, mt.object_name as source_table_name, mt.schema_name as source_schema_name, mt.row_count as source_row_count, mt.table_size as source_table_size FROM mcl.postgres_tables pt LEFT JOIN mcl.mssql_tables mt ON mt.id = pt.source_table_id;
example_queries.get_mssql_table_data: SELECT mt.*, pt.object_name as postgres_table_name, pt.schema_name as postgres_schema_name, pt.row_count as postgres_row_count, pt.table_size as postgres_table_size FROM mcl.mssql_tables mt LEFT JOIN mcl.postgres_tables pt ON pt.source_table_id = mt.id;
